milestones.outcome: The owner can open one tailnet-only page on the NAS that lists every active review across machines and links to each.
exit_criteria: The standalone stack provides the authorized, capability-protecting index with ordered durable records, stale handling and no review control; required NAS deployment evidence is recorded.
milestones.boundary: A verified hub on the NAS with push disabled. Fixture-only results leave deployment acceptance open.

milestones.outcome: The owner receives Android notifications for qualifying ready-count increases through the self-hosted tailnet service, without sending summaries or capabilities to external notification providers.
exit_criteria: Persistent throttling, account restrictions and failure isolation pass fixture checks, and an authorized screen-off Android observation demonstrates delivery of the summary and hub link.
milestones.boundary: The defined hub and optional push outcome with actual closeout evidence; iOS remains deferred.
